newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs China contracts worth $71.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs China contracts worth $71.

text.p: Sweden's Ericsson on Thursday said it had signed contracts with the Hebei Post and Telecommunications Administration in China for the expansion of GSM and TACS networks in a deal worth $71 million.
The group said in a statement that the first contract was worth $21 million and was for the expansion of the GSM network in Hebei province in northern China.
The TACS contract was worth $50 million, the group added.
"The expansions will be complete by 1997," it said.
Ericsson said it began working with the Hebei administration 10 years ago and that China was it second largest market in global terms.
